create_VariableOrdering_default: create a VariableOrdering instance from an Objective with default variable ordering enabled
create_VariableOrdering_no_default: create a VariableOrdering instance from an Objective without computing the default order
append_variable_to_ordering: append a Variable to an existing VariableOrdering instance to extend the order
remove_variable_from_ordering: remove a Variable from a VariableOrdering instance and update the index mapping
check_ordering_complete: check if a VariableOrdering is complete by comparing its length to the objective size
